title: land's landing lock is taken by whichever waiter polls first, so a waiter can starve until its 30 min bound refuses it and the orchestrator reruns it by hand
goal: waiters of the clone's landing lock take it in the order they asked (a ticket or queue file beside the lock), so a land that has waited longest is next and a sprint's landings do not end refused at step landing-lock while younger waiters pass them

run: import sys; src = open("_tools/bl_close.py", encoding="utf-8").read(); sys.exit(0 if "ticket" in src or "queue" in src.lower() else 1)
